verdictStatement: REJECT at 0 blockers and 1 SHOULD-FIX. Nearly everything holds: the three-class list is == equal across the join's two copies, live G14 v1, live catalog v1 and the live DR-G14 harness cell; OBL-G14-NAMED-CATALOG is leftoverDesign false in specifiedNotLeftover and declines to close the fixture obligation; OBL-G14-FX-AUTHORING remains the sole leftover; the DR-118 obligations are named as remaining elsewhere and I confirmed all three still carry leftoverDesign true on language-quality-leftover-join.v2; no threshold, Rust-as-core, second language role or D9 code appears; G13 is mentioned only in denials and as a DR-118 leftover identifier; all seventeen cited digests match; artifact and version are both 1; required-now is 26; and the subject did not move. It fails on one field. The artifact declares registerRow DR-G14 and gives file08StatusToken as 'SATISFIED Class B (D-091); G14 not QUALIFIED', but the live DR-G14 token is OPEN — 'SATISFIED Class B (D-091)' is DR-119's standing, and no registerRowNote says the field describes a different row. The artifact attributes that standing correctly everywhere else, including a dedicated obligation naming DR-119 as the SATISFIED row, which is why this is a SHOULD-FIX rather than a blocker; but every join in this corpus turns on the row token being read straight from file 08, and this one returns SATISFIED for a row that is OPEN.
